messages:
Priya: Need a rapid cross-team alignment for the 'capacity-slate' pilot. Product wants steady 3k rps @ ~220ms p95, absorb bursts to 7k rps for up to 20m. Key asks: prewarm strategy, reserved burst plan, KMS/HSM onboarding, canary rollout model, and concrete rollback triggers. cc @Ethan @Maya @Leo @Sam @Nora
Ethan: Quick question: do we mandate reserved prewarm slots or try an aggressive autoscale + predictive prefill? For predictable p95 I'd lean toward reserved prewarm.
Maya: Runtime preference: reserve slots + KV prefix prefill for top ~120 prefixes, 8min prewarm window. Also need a compact quantized fallback model id (redwood-mini-q5) and a per-tenant pinning for canaries.
Leo: Infra can carve a burst pool but scheduler needs minimum 36h lead time for GPU reservations. Also, HSM-backed KMS onboarding requires an access review and 1 maintenance window for key rotation. What's the expected SLA?
Priya: SLA target: 99.95% first 14 days, then re-evaluate. HSM/KMS required due to customer key obligations  I'll open the onboarding ticket today.
Sam: Security ok with HSM/KMS. Need a short threat-model (30m) and an IaC policy PR that enforces least-privilege on key roles. Confirmed telemetry will be scrubbed of PII before export.
Nora: PM note: customers want visibility into quality tradeoffs when fallback occurs. We need a 1-pager showing latency vs semantic-similarity (embedding recall/top-k) for redwood-mini-q5 vs primary model so support knows what to expect.
Ethan: For rollout, tenant-scoped canaries + percent ramps sound right. Can we support both soft percent canaries and explicit tenant lists?
Maya: Yes. Runtime supports both. Example rollout stanza we'll include in the spec: ```json
{"canary": {"mode":"tenant_list","tenants":["acct-123","acct-789"] ,"percent_ramp": [5,20,50]}, "fallback_model":"redwood-mini-q5"}
```
Leo: I'll start the reservation request for a 3-node burst pool and set autoscale grace to 25m. Scheduler ETA: reservation ticket submitted within 2h; approval expected within 36h.
Priya: Action items: Priya -> open HSM/KMS onboarding ticket (#TICKET-6801) + notify customers; Ethan -> add canary flags + doc fallback behavior by EOD Tue; Maya -> publish prefix warmlist + attach eval prompts and quality curve; Leo -> submit reservation req and post reservation id; Sam -> schedule threat-model within 48h and open IaC PR; Nora -> draft customer-facing quality tradeoff one-pager.
Ethan: Suggested rollback rules: sustained p95 >450ms for 10m OR error_rate >0.75% for 5m OR embedding-recall drop >7% -> rollback to previous stable model. We should codify these as alerts + an automated rollback runbook.
Maya: Agreed. I'll add synthetic checks and a continuous eval harness that runs the small prompt set every 5m. Metrics: gen p95, error rate, embedding top-5 recall, token-cost delta.
infra-bot: reservation created: req-99012; ETA approval 2024-10-02T11:00Z
Priya: Nice. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock this scope and trigger the tickets. Also: tagging for release notes and support KB is needed  Nora please own support doc.
Nora: Will do. I'll coordinate with Support and prepare a short SLA FAQ and rollback explanation.
Ethan: :thumbsup: One small ask  include expected costs for reserved pool in the doc so finance can approve quickly.
Leo: I'll attach a cost estimate to the reservation ticket.
Priya: Great. Locking scope pending final reservation approval.
